title: Implement audit log export to JSON (CLI subcommand)
description:
Add `transit audit-export [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--type EVENT_TYPE]` CLI subcommand that reads the audit log and writes newline-delimited JSON to stdout. Supports filtering by time range and event type. Artifact: transit/src/cli/audit.rs.

Acceptance: output is valid newline-delimited JSON (one JSON object per line); --since and --until filter correctly; --type filters by event_type column; empty result set outputs nothing (not an error)
